text:
hana: Quick bug report on the Next + Tailwind + LangChain starter: local dev SSR sometimes gets 401s on first load. Client-side calls fine.

ricardo: Are you using the dev auth proxy cookie flow?

hana: Yes. Flow: /api/session sets cookie, getServerSideProps calls /api/run which reads req.cookies.token. Intermittent missing cookie.

ellie: That usually smells like a propagation race in next dev. Can you log req.headers.cookie at the API entry?

hana: Did that. On failures cookie header empty. Adding a 60ms delay makes it disappear less often.

porter: Two minimal example fixes: (1) add a dev-only token-read helper that retries once with small jitter; (2) add a README troubleshooting bullet showing server-side token mint pattern. Keep production behavior unchanged.

r ricardo: For streaming examples also check cancel behavior. If the starter exposes SSE and the server doesn't abort the SDK stream on client disconnect, serverless invocations can hang.

hana: Good point. Our stream example just iterates and writes chunks. I'll patch it to listen for req.on('close') and call iterator.return() as a fallback.

ellie: If SDK supports AbortSignal, pass it into stream. Otherwise the iterator.return() shim is fine for examples. Add mock tests in eval-harness so CI is deterministic.

porter: Can someone open a tiny PR to examples that: adds dev-token helper behind NODE_ENV !== 'production', updates stream example with close->return shim, and appends a Troubleshooting item to README? Keep logs debug-only.

hana: I'll open PR 3176543211-dev-token-retry-stream-shim. Tests will mock cookie store and stream iterator, no sleeps.

test-bot: Reminder: examples CI will run. Mark timing tests as mock-only.

porter: Thanks. This should reduce early onboarding tickets for the starter. :thumbsup:
